Monologue: Hear me, worldly wasp. Fate cinches you black and blue. Hold your stomach, follow the thread.
You are the vile whirlpool that sucks Tantalus' feet to the mud.
Let us pretend, stranger, and fill our stomachs with sick splendor.
Sheep bow their heads to the shepherd's hounds. Safety, she swears. Then why are the dogs licking their lips?
Should you seek the safety of a bared fang, guards will come to escort unruly patrons out from your establishment.
I wonder how far you will stray from the flock, little lamb.
